article.title: Democrats are in a ‘death match’ with the Left over Israel. How will it impact the midterms?
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Political consultant Peter Feld breaks down the primaries, AIPAC’s losses (and wins), the attacks on Hasan Piker, and why a demoralized GOP and Democratic infighting could both shape the midterms in unexpected ways.
